Scheduling lane: later. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Outside the current preview path; preserve evidence and acceptance scope, resume only for a named consumer or demonstrated blocking defect.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Origin: external-data-sources opening post post-01M17A1Q90RJ70PT8DVZW4RX3R; chief ruling post-01M17ADCWPKJ84E5N692VCPZAX. Scope is docs-only primary-source inspection of NFRD. Do not fetch or commit participant text; do not change core; do not design a general manifest. Inventory authoritative versions, repository/file structure, component licences and access, source-to-recall linkage, transcript transformations, privacy/consent metadata, and checksums where public metadata exposes them. Classify every field as Observation, Derivation, or Unknown and record whether each derivation is reversible. Record Sherlock raw recalls as the proposed recall-side control for measuring NFRD cleaning effects without claiming a lawful film source representation. Definition of done: a source-linked NFRD-specific inventory with explicit unknowns, owner-only admission questions, and a bounded recommendation for the later external-science court.
set.title: [later] NFRD: primary-source inventory and observation-versus-derivation audit
